body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.75 (naive base rate 0.70) that: Persistent Systems announces completion (closing) of its Nagarro acquisition on or before 31-Mar-2027. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (15-Oct-2026): voluntary public takeover offer for Nagarro reached ~94.04% of share capital after the additional acceptance period (ended 6-Oct); squeeze-out planned after closing. All merger-control and FDI clearances received except Austria and Spain ('confident… over the next several weeks'); RBI approval applied for. Financing: €1.4 bn 18-month bridge to be replaced; $1.25 bn long-term raise incl. $450 mn equity — QIP opened 21-Oct-2026 and allotments followed (NSE filings 26-Oct, 4-Nov). CEO: 'We expect the deal closure by Q4-CY26 or Q1-CY27.' Q2: revenue $487.6 mn (+20% YoY), EBIT 15%, ₹185 cr deal costs. Reasoning: Acceptance and financing — usually the hard parts — are done; what remains is two FDI screens and RBI. Persistent's stated window ends exactly on our date, so a modest slip would flip it. Slightly above base. Resolution: YES if, on or before 31-Mar-2027, Persistent (NSE filing or press release) announces that the Nagarro acquisition/offer has completed (settlement/closing of the takeover offer). Completion of the later squeeze-out is not required. Announcement only of further approvals = NO. Source: Persistent Systems NSE announcements / press releases. Resolve by 2027-04-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
